'''Duke Ramon III''' is a human located in [[Stormwind Keep]] in the city of [[Stormwind City|Stormwind]]. He is a member of the influential House of Nobles and can be found in the [[Petitioner's Chamber]], the first room on the right through the keep's main entrance. It was at his behest that [[Harlus Ashbuckle|Martin Corinth]]'s execution was delayed and that he was released from the Stockades.
